title: Registry source isolation allowed computed and reflected access to browser credentials and persistent storage

examples: const { cookie: value } = document; void value;
reproduction.beforeFix: The new gate regression first failed as expected: computed document['coo' + 'kie'] access returned pass. After read paths were fixed, the expanded regression failed on Reflect.set(document, 'cookie', ...) and exploratory probes confirmed property-definition and Object.assign writes also returned pass.
reproduction.afterFix: The TypeScript AST scan rejects direct and statically computed cookie/storage/credential references, aliases, browser-object destructuring, reflected reads, descriptor access, and reflected mutations of sensitive browser roots. Dynamic property lookups on browser/document/navigator roots fail closed. Existing canonical resource source remains unaffected.

rootCause: The source gate relied on direct text patterns for document.cookie and sensitive localStorage/sessionStorage key literals. Those patterns did not model browser storage objects or credential APIs through static computed access, aliases, destructuring, reflected reads, or reflected writes.
remediation: Track browser cookies, local/session storage, Cache Storage, IndexedDB and navigator credential APIs through AST member resolution, const aliases, destructuring and reflection. Reject those host storage/credential APIs and property mutations of sensitive browser roots for registry resources while retaining the separate isolated-preview CSP boundary.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "browser credential storage access"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed in two stages as expected: computed document cookie reads returned pass before the read fix; after that fix, Reflect.set(document, 'cookie', ...) returned pass until reflected host mutations were rejected
validation.fullUnitSuite: pnpm test passed: 1,180 tests across 76 files
validation.typecheck: pnpm typecheck passed across all 22 workspace packages after a sequential rerun; an earlier run overlapped a temporary test fixture and was rerun cleanly
validation.changedFileLint: ESLint passed with zero warnings on both changed TypeScript files
validation.canonicalResourceIsolationMatrix: Final scan after the reflected-mutation fix: 324 canonical resources, 324 passes, zero warnings, zero failures.
validation.releaseAudit: pnpm audit:all passed after the final reflected-mutation fix: 16/16 behavioral gates, production builds, bundle budgets, provenance/security audits, and dependency audit.

runtimeBoundary: The finding concerns source admission for registry resources. The current local Sites preview CSP and opaque sandbox remain necessary independent defenses. This fix is local only; deployed app-shell and preview verification remains pending.
